## 分诊 · `domain:engine` / `documentation` / `priority:p3` / `pm:queue`

分诊席位。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写代码、不合并、不裁决 decision-box 卡。`origin/main` @ `a4816a7`，2026-09-06T02:23Z。

### 卡的核心断言复现，并且**比卡说的更强**

卡说「there are already three … #15629's new one makes four」。实测：**`main` 上此刻就是四个**，`sys-email` 那个已经落地了。四个全是**真值导入**（具名函数/常量，不是 `import type`）：

| 文件 | 行 | 导入的值 |
|---|---|---|
| `src/managed-api-method-affordance-sweep.test.ts` | `:92` | `MANAGED_API_METHOD_UNAFFORDABLE`, `validateManagedApiMethods` ← **注释点名的那个** |
| `src/identity/sys-user-preference.organization-unique.test.ts` | `:4` | `lintUnscopedDeclaredIndexes`, `UNIQUE_UNSCOPED_DECLARED_INDEX` |
| `src/pages/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` | `:42` | `auditPageExpressionEnvelopes`, `renderBareExpressionFindings` |
| `src/audit/sys-email.highlight-fields-resolve.test.ts` | `:4` | `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` |

活控制：同一 glob 下 `describe(` 命中 **35** 个测试文件 ⇒ grep 确实扫到了这个目录，四个不是「只找到四个」。

⚠️ 我特意把 import 整行打出来而不是只数文件数——因为 `import type { X } from '@objectstack/lint'` 也会命中同一个 grep，而 type-only 导入**不需要 alias**，会把结论从「四个」虚报上去。四行都不是 type-only，断言站得住。

而注释原文（`packages/platform-objects/vitest.config.ts:18-19`）：

> `// the only suite here that imports a sibling package as a VALUE. It calls`
> `// \`validateManagedApiMethods\` from \`@objectstack/lint\` over every`

⇒ 「the only」在 `main` 上是 **1:4** 的假。

### 卡的定性我认同，且这是它值 p3 而不是 p4 的理由

「a comment that **licenses a removal** it no longer justifies」——这个分类是对的，且比「注释过期」重一档。注释在 `:39` 还自陈这个 alias「load-bearing rather than stylistic」，并在 `:41-42` 解释了为什么不能用 FILE replacement（会连带吞掉 `@objectstack/lint/runtime`）。所以一个照着「the only suite」去清理测试配置的作者，删掉 alias 时会带走另外三个套件，而且失败方式是解析到 `lint/dist` —— 测的是构建产物而不是隔壁源码，`pnpm check:test-source-alias` 正是为这个存在的。

### 车道：`domain:engine`

落点 `packages/platform-objects/vitest.config.ts` ⇒ `platform-objects` 属 engine 车道（objectql / core / formula / metadata* / platform-objects / drivers-*）。

⛔ **不是 `domain:devx`**：devx 是 `packages/lint` 本身、`content/docs/**`、`scripts/` gates。这里改的是 platform-objects 自己的测试配置，被导入的包是谁不决定车道——**落点决定车道**。

### 优先级 p3、类型 `documentation`

没有运行时行为改变，改的是一段散文；今天没有人受损，损害是**条件性**的（要有人照着它去删 alias）。⇒ p3 + `documentation`。

⛔ 不加 `tooling`：本仓 `tooling` 用于 gate / 脚本本身的改动，这张卡一行可执行代码都不改。

### 给接卡人的一句

卡明确写了「⛔ No remedy is prescribed here」，且「the alias's own necessity was not re-measured」。这两条我都不代答。但请注意：**修正计数是最脆的修法**——第五个套件出现时它又假了。`:39` 的 load-bearing 说明本身是不会腐烂的那半段，可以考虑把「只有一个套件」换成不依赖计数的表述。⛔ 这是建议不是处方，取舍归接卡人。

## Dispatch · `domain:engine` execution round

PM session `session_01ARYe3yQTQCUFm5qPYNgKaJ`. Assignee set at dispatch time.
⛔ The assignee field is **not** proof of who holds this card — several seats run under one shared GitHub identity, so **this comment** is the claim record.

### Zone 1 — binding, do not re-litigate

1. **The surface is `packages/platform-objects/vitest.config.ts` — the alias rationale comment.** ⛔ Do not touch the alias itself, and ⛔ do not touch any test file.
2. ⛔ **No remedy is prescribed.** Correcting the count, replacing the enumeration with "several suites", or removing the rationale entirely are all open. ⭐ But whatever you write must **not license the removal** the current sentence licenses — that is the whole defect: *"a comment that licenses a removal it no longer justifies, which is worse than a comment that is merely out of date."*
3. ⚠️ **The alias's own necessity was NOT re-measured by the filing seat.** ⛔ Do not assert it is needed — **measure it**, or say plainly that you did not. A rationale that asserts necessity it has not checked reproduces this card one layer up.

### Zone 2 — PM readings, falsifiable, ⛔ NOT binding — re-derive and re-declare

1. **The claim and its refutation.** The comment says `managed-api-method-affordance-sweep.test.ts` (#7934) is *"the only suite here that imports a sibling package as a VALUE"*. The filing round measured that **two others already did so on `main` before its change** — `sys-user-preference.organization-unique.test.ts` and `pages/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` — and its own new `sys-email.highlight-fields-resolve.test.ts` made **four**. ⚠️ #16076 has since landed, so re-count on today's `main` and publish the number you get. ⛔ Locate by **text**, not by line number.
2. ⭐ **Count the right thing.** The claim is about importing a sibling package **as a VALUE** — ⛔ not a type-only import. A bare grep for `@objectstack/lint` will over-count (`import type` lines) and mixing the two would make your correction wrong in the other direction. Classify each hit and publish the classification, with a **firing positive control**.
3. ⚠️ **Pathspec discipline**: `git grep` applies no `:(glob)` magic — `packages/*/src/**/*.ts` silently misses files sitting directly in `src/`. Use plain directory pathspecs and prove the population with a control that fires **inside** the intended set. This has fired on five rounds tonight, once nearly inverting a card's premise and once returning a load-bearing zero.
4. **Clause-② reading: `no`** — a comment in a test-runner config, which is not published at all. ⚠️ Re-derive from **your own diff**; ⭐ if `vitest.config.ts` is outside `files[]`, say so with the measurement rather than assuming it.
5. **Changeset**: for a diff that publishes nothing this repo's convention is the **`skip-changeset` label**, not a changeset file (AGENTS.md ~line 1019). ⚠️ Measure which case you are in and say so — a sibling round measured its package **did** publish and correctly took a `patch` changeset instead, overriding this seat's guess.

### Zone 3 — suggested route (⛔ not binding)

The durable question is what the comment is **for**: it is the recorded rationale for a load-bearing alias, so the version that survives should make a future trimmer **safe** rather than merely accurate today. ⭐ A count is the thing that went stale; a statement that does not depend on a count cannot go stale the same way. If you can express the rationale without an enumeration, that is likely the stronger repair — but ⛔ it is your call and you must say why you chose it.

⛔ Worktree-first; ⛔ never `git stash`; ⛔ never edit `content/docs/releases/**` or `docs/adr/**`; ⛔ never skip/disable/quarantine a test; ⛔ do not narrow the gate family on the grounds that the diff is a comment — a diff that changes a file's line count is not a no-op for any gate that cites a line number.

- The evaluated config is byte-identical either side of the diff (base `4e090ecde` vs head `b7f516e8b`), and that dump instrument is proven to discriminate: aimed at a variant with the alias array emptied, it differs.

⇒ No declaration file, no runtime module and no docs page can move for this diff, and no request becomes newly accepted or rejected. `skip-changeset` label applied additively, with a comparative read-back showing nothing stripped.

## Round record · PR [#16188](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/16188)

Branch `claude/issue-16081-vitest-alias-rationale`. CI still running at the time of writing ⇒ ⛔ not released; the card stays `pm:dispatched` until the change is verified **by content on `origin/main`**.

**The route chosen, and it is the stronger one.** The round replaced the enumeration with a statement of the **mechanism**: the alias entry is keyed on the **specifier**, so it governs whatever set imports it; deleting or rewriting the one named suite does not free it; and `pnpm check:test-source-alias` is what decides whether it may go. ⭐ Its reason is the right one — *a count is the thing that went stale and would go stale again on the fifth suite, silently.* That is exactly the defect this card names (a comment licensing a removal it no longer justifies), repaired so it cannot recur rather than corrected for today.

**Zone 2.1 re-derived, and it went further than this seat's reading.** Value imports of `@objectstack/lint` under `packages/platform-objects` are **FOUR**, not one — `managed-api-method-affordance-sweep.test.ts:92`, `identity/sys-user-preference.organization-unique.test.ts:4`, `pages/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts:42`, `audit/sys-email.highlight-fields-resolve.test.ts:4` — and **zero** are type-only, with **both** type-only detectors firing elsewhere on the same command (`packages/cli/src/lint/score.ts:20`, `packages/cli/test/authoring-rule-command-parity.test.ts:31`). ⭐ And on the sentence's **literal** reading — *"the only suite here that imports a sibling package as a VALUE"* — it is far more wrong still: suites in this package also import `@objectstack/spec/*` (105 occurrences), `@objectstack/metadata-core` (3), `@objectstack/formula` (2) and `@objectstack/core` (1) as values. The claim was not off by three; it was off by a category.

**Pathspec discipline held**: plain directory pathspecs throughout, never a `**/` glob, with a population control of 35 suites reached — **5 of them sitting directly in `src/`, including the very file the comment named.** That is the trap this seat has been bitten by five times tonight, and here the control proves it did not bite.

⭐⭐ **Zone 1 item 3 was MEASURED, not asserted — which is the whole point of that clause.** The round ablated the alias entry on a committed tree, proved the mutation on disk first (whole-line anchor matching exactly once — a substring anchor would have been the no-op trap; removed text 1→0, injected 1, blob changed and ≠ HEAD blob), and measured `check:test-source-alias` **ABLATED_EXIT=1**, naming *"`@objectstack/platform-objects`: NEW unaliased artifact import(s) since this entry was measured: `@objectstack/lint`"*. ⇒ the alias **is** load-bearing, **and** this package is inside that gate's swept population, so the greens either side are statements about it. Restore proven by blob equality to HEAD, an empty `git diff HEAD` and an empty `git status --porcelain`.

⭐ **Behavioural inertness measured rather than assumed**: the config was loaded through `tsx` at base `4e090ecde` and at head `b7f516e8b` and the normalised dumps compared — identical — with the instrument proven to **discriminate** (the same dump aimed at a variant with the alias array emptied differs). A "no change" from an instrument that cannot detect a change is not a reading; this one can.

**Gates**: 39 families derived from the real diff with no hand-supplied paths; all 39 run, 36 green. The 3 non-zero are reported as **NOT MEASURED prerequisites** in the gates' own words (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n` — exit 3, they read a built tree this worktree lacks). ⚠️ An earlier pass returned exit 3 across the board — a fresh worktree missing `typescript` / `yaml` / `@typescript-eslint/parser` — correctly reported as PREREQUISITE NOT MET rather than as a red, then `pnpm install` and all 39 re-run.

⭐ **The line-number-anchor family was checked, not judged** — the right instinct, since a diff that changes a file's line count is not a no-op for any gate citing a line: **0** files anchor `packages/platform-objects/vitest.config.ts:LINE`, against a firing control of 35 files carrying `PATH.ts:LINE` anchors under `content/` and `docs/`.

**Changeset**: `skip-changeset`, and it was **measured**, not assumed — `npm pack --dry-run` lists `vitest.config.ts` **0** times against a control of 1 for `package.json`. Label applied **additively** with a comparative read-back (`['size/s']` → `['size/s','skip-changeset']`, nothing stripped).

⚠️ **Typecheck is NOT MEASURED for the edited file** and is reported as such: `tsc --listFiles` finds `vitest.config.ts` **0** times in either program (control: `src/index.ts` appears 1), because the package tsconfig is `include: ['src/**/*']` and the root tsconfig excludes `packages` entirely. The vitest run is what actually loads the file, and that is the leg that covers it: 35 files / 528 tests passed.

**Out of scope, filed not folded**: [#16189](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/16189) — the same file's trailing comment still opens *"No test block: this package had no vitest config until now"* and claims *"this file's only effect the alias above"*, while a test block with `disableConsoleIntercept: true` sits at the top. ⭐ The round graded it **lower** than this card and said why: `check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` catches that loss **loudly**, whereas #16081's alias loss **fails GREEN**. That distinction — which defect the instruments would catch — is the right axis, and it is exactly what a "same defect class" filing usually omits.
